Title: Q: Multiple target of a blood loss card (i.e. KRC)

Messages.Author: GP41
Messages.Body:
Hi again,

This one has to be cleared out in my head. I did asked a similar
question in the past, but i wonder about the effect on this one.

Here it goes:

1st) 5 player table

2nd) Pool left: A has 3
B, C, D, and E all have 1

3rd) Player A calls a Kine Resources Contested, no one blocks. Terms
are that B, C, D, and E lose 1 pool each. Vote is successful.

Q1: What happen to targeted players after vote takes effect?

Q2: Who gets a victory points?

Q3: Who gets the regular 6 pools by having its prey ousted?

Other votes have similar effect. Conservative Agitation, Anarchist
Uprising, Ancilla Empowerment,... Will these cards have to be handle
the same way?

GP41

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
GP41 <GP...@videotron.ca> wrote in message
news:3ACBF415...@videotron.ca...

> Hi again,
>
> This one has to be cleared out in my head. I did asked a similar
> question in the past, but i wonder about the effect on this one.
>
> Here it goes:
>
> 1st) 5 player table
>
> 2nd) Pool left: A has 3
> B, C, D, and E all have 1
>
> 3rd) Player A calls a Kine Resources Contested, no one blocks. Terms
> are that B, C, D, and E lose 1 pool each. Vote is successful.
>
> Q1: What happen to targeted players after vote takes effect?

They are all ousted.
All but E gain one victory point.
A also gains one victory point and six blood.

> Q2: Who gets a victory points?

Each Methuselah whose prey was ousted by the vote gains a victory point.

> Q3: Who gets the regular 6 pools by having its prey ousted?

Only the player who is not ousted without the six pool, ie player A.

> Other votes have similar effect. Conservative Agitation, Anarchist
> Uprising, Ancilla Empowerment,... Will these cards have to be handle
> the same way?

Ousting multiple players in the same action is always handled exactly the
same way.
See section 9 of the Sabbat War Rulebook, particularly the Exception under
9.1 Victory Points.

http://www.thelasombra.com/rulebook.htm#9.1

http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/rulebook/rulebook.html#sec9_1

Carpe Noctem.

Lasombra

http://www.TheLasombra.com
